page.overview:
Who is Elsa?

Elsa was a staff member who worked at the Gentle Giants Petting Zoo and held baby Gallimimus for kids to pet. When the petting zoo was attacked by pterosaurs that had broken out of the Aviary, Elsa helped to evacuate the children present at the time.

It is unknown what happened to her during the Jurassic World Incident.
